messages.content: Calculate the probability of getting a head when flipping a coin.

message.content:
For a fair (unbiased) coin, each flip has two equally likely outcomes: heads (H) or tails (T).  
The probability \(P\) of getting heads is therefore

\[
P(\text{heads}) = \frac{\text{number of favorable outcomes}}{\text{total possible outcomes}}
                 = \frac{1}{2}
                 = 0.5
                 = 50\%.
\]

So, when you flip a fair coin, there’s a 50 % chance of landing on heads.
